info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Warehouse Inventory Reorders-v2-spec
info.description: The Warehouse Inventory Reorder Management API enables businesses to efficiently monitor and retrieve information regarding inventory reorders across warehouses. This endpoint allows users to list all current product reorder requirements, ensuring that stock levels are appropriately maintained. Ideal for inventory managers and supply chain professionals, it provides insights into inventory status and helps facilitate timely restocking to prevent shortages. Utilize this API to optimize inventory management and ensure operational efficiency.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the current status and requirements for reordering inventory. It is designed to assist in managing stock levels effectively and ensuring timely restocking of items.

requestBody.description: Request body for reordering inventory items. This body should contain the necessary details required for processing the reorder operation, ensuring all specified fields adhere to the defined schema.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the current inventory reorder details.

ListWarehouseInventoryReordersRequest.title: Inventory Reorder Request Body
ListWarehouseInventoryReordersRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for inventory reorder operations in the API. It consists of a JSON string that contains the necessary details for the reorder operation.

ListWarehouseInventoryReordersResponse_2.title: Inventory Reorder Response

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A reference number associated with the reorder operation.

resultId.description: The unique identifier for the result of the reorder operation.

state.description: Current state of the reorder operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the reorder operation, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional context about the reorder operation.

ListWarehouseInventoryReordersResponse_2.description: Response schema for the inventory reorder operation upon a successful GET request.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

AuditInfo.description: Information related to the auditing of the reorder operation.
